title: Bridge customer logos
description: A quiet customer wall on white: one regular-weight line of praise, then thirteen wordmarks centred in rows of five, five and three with generous air, and an ink-outlined button below. On phones the line goes left-aligned over three lines and the names sit one, then two per row.
notes: names render as plain text wordmarks (with an optional small icon); swap in real logos through the logo slot
the first name takes a whole row on phones
